description:
[Game reference] Stack size of every item. Every live item's vanilla `stack` size (how many fit in one inventory slot) with `name`, `shortname`,
`category` and item `url`, alphabetical - the list on rust.wiki/stack-sizes. `no_limit` is true for liquids,
which the game stores without a real limit. Servers can change stack sizes with plugins.

q.description: Substring of the item name or shortname.

name: get_stack_sizes
title: Stack size of every item
